details.jobDescription: Lead administrative operations and workplace services, ensuring smooth coordination of office and factory support activities.
details.jobPurpose: To manage day-to-day administration and support efficient, organized and compliant workplace operations.
responsibilities: Oversee general administration, office facilities and workplace services.
Coordinate transport, housekeeping, security, utilities and administrative support requirements.
Maintain administrative records, service arrangements and documentation.
Coordinate with departments, suppliers and service providers for operational needs.
Support management with administrative reporting, planning and issue resolution.
Promote disciplined workplace practices and compliance with company procedures.
details.educationExperience: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management or a related field with around 5 years of relevant administrative experience, preferably in a manufacturing or corporate environment.
skills: Strong administrative and organizational skills.
Good communication, coordination and problem-solving ability.
Proficiency in MS Office and routine administrative reporting.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and external service providers.
Professional conduct, confidentiality and attention to detail.

details.jobDescription: Manage front-desk and reception activities while providing professional assistance to visitors, callers and employees.
details.jobPurpose: To provide a welcoming, organized and professional reception service and support day-to-day administrative coordination.
responsibilities: Receive and guide visitors, guests and service providers professionally.
Handle incoming calls, messages and routine correspondence.
Maintain visitor records and coordinate access as required.
Support meeting arrangements, document handling and basic administrative tasks.
Coordinate with HR, Administration and other departments for visitor and office requirements.
Maintain a clean, organized and professional reception area.
details.educationExperience: Bachelor's degree or relevant diploma in Management, Business Administration or a related field with 1–2 years of relevant experience.
skills: Professional communication and interpersonal skills.
Good spoken and written English and Nepali.
Basic MS Office and record-keeping skills.
Pleasant personality, punctuality and customer-service orientation.
Ability to handle visitors and routine tasks with discretion.

vacancies.title: Driver (For Office Vehicle / Pick Up Van)

details.jobDescription: Safely operate assigned office and pick-up vehicles for official transportation, staff movement and business requirements.
details.jobPurpose: To provide safe, reliable and timely transportation while maintaining the assigned vehicle in good operating condition.
responsibilities: Drive company vehicles safely and responsibly according to assigned schedules.
Transport staff, documents, materials and authorized visitors as required.
Perform routine vehicle checks and report maintenance or safety issues.
Maintain vehicle cleanliness, logbooks, fuel records and required documents.
Follow traffic rules, company driving procedures and safety requirements.
Support administrative and marketing transportation needs when assigned.
details.educationExperience: Valid driving licence appropriate for the assigned vehicle with at least 3 years of professional driving experience; clean driving record and practical knowledge of local routes.
skills: Safe and defensive driving practices.
Knowledge of local roads and routes.
Basic vehicle inspection and maintenance awareness.
Punctuality, reliability and responsible handling of company property.
Professional behaviour and confidentiality.

details.jobDescription: Manage core HR activities including recruitment, employee administration, attendance, employee relations and HR coordination.
details.jobPurpose: To support an effective workforce and ensure HR processes are implemented consistently across the factory and office.
responsibilities: Coordinate recruitment, onboarding and employee documentation.
Maintain personnel files, attendance and HR records accurately.
Support payroll inputs, leave administration and employee-related documentation.
Coordinate employee relations, HR communication and workplace activities.
Support training, performance-management and employee-engagement activities.
Ensure HR practices follow company policies and applicable requirements.
Prepare routine HR reports and coordinate with management on manpower matters.
details.educationExperience: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management or a related field with 2–3 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
skills: Working knowledge of HR administration and employee lifecycle processes.
Strong communication, coordination and interpersonal skills.
Good MS Office and HR documentation skills.
Confidentiality, fairness and sound judgement.
Ability to handle employee matters professionally and maintain accurate records.

details.jobDescription: Plan, coordinate and monitor production activities across assigned manufacturing operations to achieve production, quality, safety and efficiency objectives.
details.jobPurpose: To ensure safe, efficient and consistent production in coordination with Quality, Engineering, Warehouse, Planning and other support functions.
responsibilities: Plan daily and periodic production activities according to requirements.
Monitor production output, manpower, materials and equipment utilization.
Coordinate with Quality Control to maintain product and process standards.
Coordinate with Engineering and Utility & Maintenance for equipment availability.
Ensure production activities follow GMP, hygiene, safety and approved procedures.
Monitor production records, downtime, wastage and operational performance.
Lead production teams and support continuous improvement initiatives.
details.educationExperience: Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Production, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field with around 5 years of relevant manufacturing/production experience.
skills: Production planning and team leadership.
Understanding of GMP, hygiene, food safety and manufacturing controls.
Problem-solving, root-cause analysis and continuous-improvement mindset.
Good reporting, coordination and decision-making skills.
Ability to work under production targets and operational pressure.

details.jobDescription: Support and coordinate daily production activities for Coffee or Nutraceutical manufacturing while developing practical production-management capability.
details.jobPurpose: To contribute to safe, efficient and consistent production operations and build competency in manufacturing processes.
responsibilities: Assist with daily production planning and line coordination.
Monitor production activities, manpower, materials and process parameters.
Ensure operators follow approved SOPs, GMP, hygiene and safety practices.
Maintain production records and report deviations, downtime and material issues.
Coordinate with Quality, Warehouse and Engineering teams as required.
Support housekeeping, line clearance and continuous-improvement activities.
details.educationExperience: Bachelor's degree or diploma in Food Technology, Industrial/Production Engineering, Pharmacy, Biotechnology or a related field; 1–3 years of relevant experience preferred. Fresh candidates may be considered for trainee placement.
skills: Basic understanding of manufacturing and production processes.
Good communication and teamwork.
Ability to learn SOPs, GMP and production documentation.
Basic computer and reporting skills.
Attention to detail, discipline and willingness to work in shifts.

details.jobDescription: Supervise production-line activities and operators to ensure safe, efficient and consistent execution of the assigned Coffee or Nutra production process.
details.jobPurpose: To maintain smooth line operations, manpower discipline, productivity and compliance with approved production procedures.
responsibilities: Allocate operators and monitor attendance and line manpower.
Supervise production activities according to SOPs and production plans.
Monitor line output, material usage, downtime and process issues.
Ensure GMP, hygiene, safety and housekeeping requirements are followed.
Coordinate with Production Officer, Quality and Engineering for deviations and equipment issues.
Maintain line records and communicate shift handover information.
details.educationExperience: Diploma or bachelor's degree in a relevant technical, food, production or manufacturing field with 2–3 years of production-line supervisory experience.
skills: Production-line supervision and team coordination.
Knowledge of GMP, hygiene and workplace safety.
Good communication and shift-handover skills.
Problem-solving and attention to process details.
Ability to work in a manufacturing environment and shifts.

details.jobDescription: Operate Coffee production equipment and perform assigned processing and packing activities according to approved procedures and quality standards.
details.jobPurpose: To operate the assigned production line safely and consistently while meeting output and quality requirements.
responsibilities: Operate and monitor assigned Coffee production equipment.
Follow SOPs, GMP, hygiene and safety requirements.
Check basic process conditions and report abnormalities promptly.
Maintain production records and support line clearance and housekeeping.
Handle materials and finished products according to instructions.
Support troubleshooting and routine cleaning activities with the responsible team.
details.educationExperience: Relevant technical education or vocational training with 2–3 years of experience operating Coffee, beverage, food or similar manufacturing equipment.
skills: Practical machine-operation skills.
Understanding of basic production and food-hygiene practices.
Attention to quality, safety and process parameters.
Basic record keeping and communication.
Willingness to work shifts and follow production schedules.

details.jobDescription: Operate and monitor sieving and bending-related equipment in the Nutra production process while maintaining process and hygiene standards.
details.jobPurpose: To perform assigned Nutra processing operations safely and consistently according to approved procedures.
responsibilities: Operate assigned sieving and bending/process equipment as instructed.
Monitor material flow and basic operating conditions.
Follow SOPs, GMP, hygiene, safety and contamination-control practices.
Maintain process and production records accurately.
Perform cleaning, line clearance and housekeeping activities.
Report equipment abnormalities, material issues and process deviations.
details.educationExperience: Relevant technical/vocational qualification or secondary education with 1–2 years of experience in food, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical or similar manufacturing operations.
skills: Basic machine-operation and process-monitoring ability.
Good hygiene and safety awareness.
Attention to detail and accurate record keeping.
Ability to follow SOPs and work in shifts.
Teamwork and willingness to learn.

details.jobDescription: Support Coffee production and packing activities, including material handling, line preparation, packing assistance and housekeeping.
details.jobPurpose: To provide reliable operational support to the Coffee production/packing team while maintaining hygiene and safety standards.
responsibilities: Assist operators with production and packing-line activities.
Handle approved materials and packaging items carefully.
Support line clearance, cleaning and housekeeping.
Follow GMP, hygiene, safety and work instructions.
Assist with counting, packing and basic production records as assigned.
Report abnormalities or material shortages to the supervisor.
details.educationExperience: Basic education/secondary level preferred; fresh candidates with 0–1 year experience may be considered.
skills: Willingness to learn and follow instructions.
Good hygiene and safety awareness.
Physical fitness for factory work.
Punctuality, discipline and teamwork.
Ability to work shifts and maintain workplace cleanliness.

details.jobDescription: Support Quality Control activities for Coffee or Nutra operations through sampling, basic testing, documentation and compliance checks under supervision.
details.jobPurpose: To help maintain product and process quality by following approved QC procedures and accurate documentation.
responsibilities: Assist in collection and handling of samples according to procedures.
Support routine physical, chemical or basic quality checks as assigned.
Maintain QC records, worksheets and sample identification accurately.
Follow laboratory hygiene, safety and good documentation practices.
Report abnormal observations or results to the responsible QC personnel.
Support housekeeping and organization of the QC/laboratory area.
details.educationExperience: Bachelor's degree or relevant diploma in Food Technology, Chemistry, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or a related field; fresh graduates may be considered.
skills: Basic knowledge of quality-control and laboratory practices.
Good documentation and observation skills.
Understanding of hygiene, GMP and food-safety principles.
Careful, methodical and detail-oriented working style.
Willingness to learn and work with both Coffee and Nutra operations.

details.jobDescription: Assist the electrical/utility team with inspection, maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical systems and factory utilities.
details.jobPurpose: To support safe and reliable electrical and utility operations across the manufacturing facility.
responsibilities: Assist with routine inspection and maintenance of electrical systems and equipment.
Support troubleshooting under supervision of qualified technical personnel.
Maintain basic maintenance records and report abnormalities.
Follow electrical safety, lockout/tagout and PPE requirements as instructed.
Assist with preventive-maintenance activities and housekeeping of electrical areas.
Coordinate with production and maintenance teams when required.
details.educationExperience: Technical diploma/CTEVT qualification or relevant electrical training; 0–1 year experience or trainee-level candidates may be considered.
skills: Basic electrical knowledge and safe working practices.
Willingness to learn industrial electrical systems.
Attention to safety and technical detail.
Basic documentation and communication skills.
Ability to work shifts and respond to operational requirements.

details.jobDescription: Perform mechanical maintenance, fitting and troubleshooting activities for Coffee and Nutra production equipment and supporting machinery.
details.jobPurpose: To maintain equipment reliability and minimize production interruptions through safe and effective mechanical maintenance.
responsibilities: Perform preventive and corrective mechanical maintenance.
Inspect machinery, identify mechanical abnormalities and assist with troubleshooting.
Carry out fitting, alignment, lubrication and component replacement as required.
Support maintenance during breakdowns and planned shutdowns.
Maintain maintenance records and report spare-parts requirements.
Follow safety procedures, PPE requirements and good housekeeping practices.
details.educationExperience: Diploma/CTEVT or equivalent technical qualification in Mechanical Engineering with 2–3 years of relevant industrial maintenance experience.
skills: Mechanical fitting and maintenance skills.
Understanding of industrial machinery and basic troubleshooting.
Ability to use common mechanical tools safely.
Preventive-maintenance mindset and attention to detail.
Teamwork, discipline and willingness to work shifts.

details.jobDescription: Support the mechanical maintenance team in routine inspection, servicing, cleaning and repair of factory machinery and utilities.
details.jobPurpose: To develop practical mechanical maintenance capability while supporting reliable factory operations.
responsibilities: Assist technicians in preventive and corrective maintenance.
Support inspection, lubrication, cleaning and basic mechanical work.
Assist with tools, spare parts and maintenance documentation.
Report abnormal sounds, vibration, leakage or equipment conditions.
Follow maintenance safety procedures and PPE requirements.
Maintain an organized and safe maintenance work area.
details.educationExperience: CTEVT/technical training in Mechanical Engineering or a related trade; fresh/trainee candidates with 0–1 year experience may be considered.
skills: Basic mechanical knowledge and tool handling.
Safety awareness and willingness to learn.
Physical fitness for industrial maintenance work.
Teamwork and discipline.
Ability to follow technical instructions and maintenance procedures.

details.jobDescription: Provide first-line IT support to users and assist with computers, networks, systems, devices and routine IT operations at the factory.
details.jobPurpose: To maintain reliable day-to-day IT support and help ensure users, systems and connectivity remain operational.
responsibilities: Provide first-line troubleshooting for Windows computers, printers and user devices.
Assist with LAN, Wi-Fi, internet and basic network troubleshooting.
Support Microsoft 365, user accounts and routine application issues.
Maintain IT asset records, device allocation and basic documentation.
Assist with backups, antivirus/security checks and IT maintenance activities.
Escalate complex infrastructure or security issues appropriately.
details.educationExperience: Diploma or bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Networking or a related field with 1–2 years of relevant IT support experience.
skills: Windows desktop and basic networking knowledge.
Hardware/software troubleshooting skills.
Basic Microsoft 365 and user-support knowledge.
Good documentation, communication and service-desk discipline.
Awareness of cybersecurity, access control and data protection.

details.jobDescription: Support procurement activities including supplier coordination, quotations, purchase documentation and timely sourcing of materials and services.
details.jobPurpose: To assist the Procurement team in obtaining required materials and services efficiently and with proper documentation.
responsibilities: Assist in obtaining and comparing supplier quotations.
Prepare and maintain purchase-related documents and records.
Coordinate with suppliers regarding quotations, delivery and documentation.
Support purchase requisition and purchase-order processes as assigned.
Maintain supplier information and procurement records.
Coordinate with Finance, Warehouse and requesting departments when required.
details.educationExperience: Bachelor's degree or relevant diploma in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Management or a related field; fresh graduates/trainees may be considered.
skills: Basic procurement and commercial awareness.
Good MS Office and documentation skills.
Communication and supplier-coordination ability.
Numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
Integrity, follow-up discipline and willingness to learn.

details.jobDescription: Assist in managing warehouse operations, inventory control, material receiving, storage and dispatch activities in coordination with Production, Procurement and Finance.
details.jobPurpose: To maintain accurate, safe and efficient warehouse operations and ensure materials are available when required.
responsibilities: Supervise receiving, storage, issue and dispatch of materials and finished goods.
Monitor inventory accuracy, stock movement and warehouse records.
Coordinate material availability with Production and Procurement.
Ensure proper storage, identification, segregation and housekeeping.
Support stock counts, reconciliation and investigation of discrepancies.
Guide warehouse staff and ensure safe material-handling practices.
details.educationExperience: Bachelor's degree or diploma in Supply Chain, Logistics, Management or a related field with 4–5 years of warehouse/inventory experience, preferably in manufacturing.
skills: Warehouse and inventory-management knowledge.
Strong organization and team-supervision skills.
Good documentation and ERP/system skills.
Understanding of stock control, FIFO/FEFO where applicable and material traceability.
Problem-solving, accuracy and safety awareness.

details.jobDescription: Coordinate daily warehouse activities including receiving, storage, material issue, inventory records and dispatch while supporting accurate stock control.
details.jobPurpose: To ensure timely and accurate movement and documentation of materials and products within the warehouse.
responsibilities: Coordinate receiving, inspection and proper storage of materials.
Prepare and maintain material issue, receipt and dispatch records.
Monitor stock levels and coordinate replenishment requirements.
Support physical stock counts and reconciliation.
Ensure materials are properly labelled, segregated and traceable.
Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Finance and transport teams.
details.educationExperience: Bachelor's degree or diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain, Management or a related field with 2–3 years of warehouse/inventory experience.
skills: Inventory and warehouse documentation skills.
Good computer/ERP and MS Office ability.
Strong coordination and follow-up.
Accuracy, organization and material-traceability awareness.
Ability to work in a factory warehouse environment.

details.jobDescription: Perform secondary packing and material-handling activities for Nutra products while following approved packing, hygiene and safety procedures.
details.jobPurpose: To support efficient and hygienic secondary packing operations and ensure packed products meet the required handling and identification standards.
responsibilities: Perform secondary packing, labelling and related manual packing activities.
Handle packaging materials and products carefully according to instructions.
Follow GMP, hygiene, safety and line-clearance requirements.
Check basic packing information and report discrepancies to the supervisor.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the packing area.
Support counting, sorting and material movement as assigned.
details.educationExperience: Basic education/secondary level preferred; previous factory or packing experience is an advantage. Fresh candidates may be considered.
skills: Good hygiene and safety awareness.
Ability to follow packing instructions accurately.
Physical fitness and manual-handling ability.
Punctuality, discipline and teamwork.
Willingness to work shifts and maintain production-area standards.
